package.description: Diagram Maker is a free diagramming and flowchart maker software. You can create organization, relationship hierarchy and structure charts.

en-US.description: Diagram Maker is a free diagramming and flowchart maker software. You can create organization, relationship hierarchy and structure charts.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft Diagram Maker is a free diagramming application and flowchart maker software. You can add, drag-and-drop shapes, create graphs, organization charts (org chart), relationship hierarchy charts and structure charts. You can also use it to generate circuit and network diagrams.

This sketch drawer software lets you to edit properties of the drawings. You can resize, rotate, flip, change colors, delete selected items, adjust line styles, and customize almost everything. The application has several built-in example diagrams.

This software is an intuitive and neatly organized application that can come in handy when you need to quickly come up with a chart or a graph. It is a feature-packed software solution that helps you easily design custom-tailored flowcharts or diagrams for a wide range of purposes.

The software includes multiple sample charts for you to analyze and experiment with. You can not only rotate elements, but also add new items or adjust spacing, alignment or dimensions, as well as bring some objects to the front while sending others to the back. You can connect and "glue" objects using the "TightConnections" property. Additionally, you can define the default parameters for the lines and solid colors deployed throughout your designs.

Once you are ready to start a project from scratch, you can choose which of the elements you need, such as rectangles, diamonds, ellipses, arcs, polygons, stars, arrows or beziers. You can also integrate text messages or bitmap pictures. When you are fully satisfied with the result, you can export it to a standalone file or print it (using your printer).
en-US.name: Vovsoft Diagram Maker
